what.text: This page follows refugees from Afghanistan living in Indonesia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3956 Afghan refugees in Indonesia, 0.1% of all refugees from Afghanistan.
Pakistan and Iran host the most Afghan refugees, followed by Germany and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Afghanistan in every year from 1993 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1998 at 5 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 6098, at the end of 2018; the main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Indonesia.
These are year-end totals for Indonesia only, reported to UNHCR.
